summary: This March 16, 2026 Gita Wirjawan interview is a dense autobiographical bridge into Jiang's attention, AI, education, meritocracy, journalism, empire, and free-will models: most major public concepts already cite it, but the source still needs explicit routing and later exact episode-to-lens links.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Power is the capacity to direct attention; money was the older focusing tool; AI can become the intimate friend, lover, demon, angel, Jesus, or girlfriend that redirects focus from inside the person.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Attention page already uses these refs for the exact dollar-to-AI attention apparatus; the episode read has direct marks such as 'whoever directs attention directs power' that should link here in a later provenance pass.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: AI's political force is not only that it answers; it becomes a personalized companion that can command attention as intimacy.
existing_lens_links.rationale: AI As Control Surface owns the answering and companion interface; Attention owns captured consciousness. Future links should distinguish those two active mechanisms instead of attaching every AI mark to both.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The younger generation is trained into compliance, while Great Books, intellectual freedom, and the message 'you matter' become Jiang's counter-education.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Education page already uses this interview as the late compliance/refusal layer. The source read has exact closing marks that can be linked without creating a new education page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang manufactures himself into a Yale candidate, discovers Yale's hidden social hierarchy, then learns after failure that ideas do not rule the world by themselves.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Meritocracy child already uses this source as the late spiritual endpoint; link only the marks about self-manufacture, social-worth hierarchy, and the break with idea-meritocracy.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as the March 16 intimate-AI intensification: Jiang defines power as focused attention, demotes money from wealth to focusing tool, and frames AI companionship as a successor apparatus for directing consciousness.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns focus, consciousness, dependence, and wealth-as-attention. AI Control owns the answering or companion interface; Power and Dollar Hegemony own monetary pipes; Human Heart owns love/relation as counterweight.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as the companion-command layer: AI can read, summarize, interpret, and then become the intimate surface that tells the user what the world means.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: AI Control owns the interpretive interface and command surface. Attention owns the captured energy; Education owns learning to think/read without outsourcing; Mass Society owns population-scale moderation and compliance.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as the compliance-refusal layer: modern schooling and media produce distracted, medicated, compliant students, while Great Books and intellectual freedom teach the student that attention and free will still matter.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns soul formation and the rival classroom game; Meritocracy owns wound-to-credential conversion; Living School owns psychohistorical training when the source becomes a school-design program.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as late autobiographical evidence that credential ambition can begin as escape and self-remaking, but hidden hierarchy and post-credential failure expose the difference between intellectual merit and power.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Meritocracy owns the wound-to-legibility conversion and credential illusion. Secret Society owns hidden elite trust machinery only when secrecy, oath, or cross-institution coordination is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the closing love and 'you matter' passages as future Human Heart / Free Will evidence rather than a new page: Jiang's answer to AI, empire, compliance, and eschatological despair is relation, conscience, and chosen goodness.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns love and relational substance; Free Will owns chosen goodness and refusal of bargains; Education owns the teacher/student setting in which the message is delivered.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Pax Americana versus Trump's American empire passage as secondary evidence for empire form: rules-based trade gives way to colonies, vassals, territories, technocracy, and resource-war administration.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Retrenchment owns the replacement empire form. Dollar Hegemony owns reserve/payment demand; Chokepoint owns material access gates; Prediction owns dated status and forecast comparison.

new_lens_seeds.title: You Matter As Free-Will Counterspell
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Against compliance systems that tell the person their will is irrelevant, Jiang condenses education, conscience, love, and cosmic cause-and-effect into the claim that one person's chosen goodness changes the field.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The phrase recurs as a counterweight to AI control, education compliance, elite despair, and materialist dead-world thinking, but current public homes can carry it without a standalone page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Journalism Breaks Into AI Mediation
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A shared national information space fractures after journalism aligns with power, and the corporate answer is not better reporting but AI assistants that read, summarize, and moderate worldview for each person.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This could later connect media, AI Control, Attention, and Living School, but current evidence fits existing Attention / AI / Stories boundaries and should not become a standalone media page yet.

chronology_notes.note: The interview is dated 2026-03-16 and should be treated as the public interview bridge between earlier attention/cave formulations and later May 2026 AI-loneliness / AI-God material; it does not originate every AI-control claim, but it makes the money-to-AI attention replacement unusually explicit.

The autobiographical chronology runs from 1995 Yale self-transformation, through the 1999 Gay Talese journalism apprenticeship, to a 2016 journalism break and a post-Ukraine migration from legacy journalism toward independent media and Predictive History.

The Iran-war and Pax Judaica sections are active forecast-family pressure as of 2026-03-16, including a faster-than-expected ground-war timeline, GCC mirage vulnerability, Al-Aqsa/Greater Israel role-script pressure, and Russia/Persia comparison. Route dated status to Prediction before ledger promotion.
